auditor.name: S S R C A & Co, Chartered Accountants (FRN: 108726W)
auditor.opinion: Unmodified opinion - the standalone Ind AS financial statements give a true and fair view in conformity with accounting principles generally accepted in India
key_audit_matters: Accounting for investments aggregating Rs 4,294.95 lakhs in equity shares as at 31st March 2026, measured at cost, FVTPL or FVTOCI based on fulfilment of required criteria involving management judgment

Fair value measurement of investments (other than investment in Associates) at each reporting date, particularly valuation of thinly traded quoted shares and unquoted equity instruments requiring significant judgement due to irregular quotation and limited liquidity

Accounting for investments aggregating Rs 4,183.02 lakhs in equity shares as at 31st March, 2026 measured at cost, FVTPL or FVTOCI based on fulfillment of required criteria which involve management judgment.

The Company's investments (other than investment in Associates) are measured at fair value at each reporting date and these fair value measurements significantly impact the Company's results. Within the Company's investment portfolio, the valuation of certain assets such as thinly traded quoted shares and the unquoted equity requires significant judgment due to their quotation not regularly available and unavailable respectively and limited liquidity in those shares.
qualifications_or_emphasis: Material uncertainty exists as on the date of the audit report that the Company is capable of meeting its liabilities existing at the date of the balance sheet as and when fall due within a period of one year from the balance sheet date
